system.description:
You rebuke undead creatures, forcing them to flee.

Undead creatures within near of you must make a Charisma check vs. your spellcasting check.

If a creature fails by 10+ points and is equal to or less than your level, it is destroyed. Otherwise, on a fail, it flees from you for 5 rounds.
